svg.title: Part 1 block compaction traced on the small disk map 12345
svg.desc: The disk map is expanded into one cell per block. A left pointer finds the first free block, a right pointer finds the last file block, and they are swapped until the pointers meet. The bottom row shows the public example after compaction.

g.text: Part 1 · two pointers, one block at a time
gold outline: the two blocks swapped in that step
disk map 12345 → blocks (file id, or . for free space)
l jumps to the next free block, r jumps back to the last file block, swap, repeat until they cross
checksum = Σ position × file id over the non-free blocks
